program_solutions:
(rule! (let ((bg (mode g -1)))
         (define (components-of color)
           (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color)) (objects g bg)))
         (define (bigger-first a b)
           (if (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
               (> (+ (obj-r1 a) (obj-c1 a)) (+ (obj-r1 b) (obj-c1 b)))
               (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))
         (define (largest objs) (fst (sort objs bigger-first)))
         (define (paint-expanded acc color obj)
           (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                  (r0 (fst bb))
                  (c0 (max 0 (- (snd bb) 1)))
                  (r1 (nth bb 2))
                  (c1 (nth bb 3))
                  (cleared (paint-cells acc (find-color g color) bg)))
             (for*/fold ((out cleared))
                        ((r (range r0 (+ r1 1))) (c (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
                        (set-cell out r c color))))
         (foldl (lambda (color acc)
                  (if (= color bg)
                      acc
                      (let ((objs (components-of color)))
                        (if (< (length objs) 2)
                            acc
                            (paint-expanded acc color (largest objs))))))
                g
                (range 0 10))))
